scope: Additive pre-rollover NYJ-NE final-gamebook reconciliation. It replaces the prior generic gamebook-availability blocker with an immutable official final gamebook, certifies final participation, quarterback and specialist coverage, preserves literal injury/return wording and exact supported intervals, and binds New England's reported offensive-line relief chain to frozen identities and values. It retains precise paired historical coverage and unresolved replacement-allocation blockers. It does not advance the active manifest, publish ratings, write current-week personnel/QB overlays, construct a fair, consult a market, or issue a bet.

sources.finding: The Patriots' official October 18 gamebook article exposes the final Jets at Patriots Week 6 gamebook PDF.

The 17-page official final gamebook records New England 26, New York 19 in regulation; final lineups, starters, substitutes, did-not-play and inactive inventories; Geno Smith and Drake Maye as the only passers; all listed kicking, punting and long-snapping duties; and the literal printed injury, questionable, out and return updates used below.

The official final inactive announcement lists Carlton Davis, Karon Prunty, Channing Canada, Dametrious Crownover, Tanner Arkin and emergency third quarterback Behren Morton for New England, and Adonai Mitchell, Breece Hall, Joseph Ossai, Dylan Parham, Nahshon Wright and Jack Heflin for New York.

The official lineup notes identify the actual New England offensive-line relief chain: Caleb Lomu entered at right tackle when Morgan Moses left; Matt Pryor entered at right guard while Ben Brown moved from right guard to left guard when Alijah Vera-Tucker left; and Walter Rouse entered at left guard when Brown left in the fourth quarter.

The official postgame observations say Romeo Doubs could not return after the first-quarter touchdown injury, identify the three New England offensive linemen who left, and report that Caleb Lomu played 59 snaps at right tackle.
New England's official roster resolves the gamebook abbreviation Dr.Jones and jersey No. 5 to frozen player identity Dre'Mont Jones.

NYJ.finding: The official final gamebook records Geno Smith as New York's only passer; Cade Klubnik did not play and no injury-driven quarterback relief occurred.

NE.finding: The official final gamebook records Drake Maye as New England's only passer; Tommy DeVito did not play, emergency third quarterback Behren Morton was inactive, and no injury-driven quarterback relief occurred.

specialistCoverage.finding: The official final gamebook records the listed players performing the game's kicking, punting/holding and long-snapping duties and prints no injury-driven specialist replacement.
